vb_textbox.text: Keep your eyes on the screen and fingers poised above s and k and thumb above space bar. get comfortable and avoid distractions. if the first characters have a tall hat start with that by pressing s or k, if the amount of mushrooms is high maintian the high hat choice untill the amount goes low then swith to the small hat by pressing s or k. make sure to press spae as soon as you have chosen your side. I kept up the speed between choice and collecting. good luck
